evidence: The applicability of the Al2O3 films as effective gas barrier layers (GBLs) was successfully demonstrated wherein coating on polyethylene terephthalate (PET) substrates yielded very good oxygen transmission rates (OTR) with an improvement factor of 86 for a 15nm film using DMAD and a factor of 25 for a film thickness of just 5 nm using BDEDA compared to bare PET substrates.
